listing.aiSummary: Adds two new missions detailing the origin of the Black Star and the battle before the sinking of the HSS Bis'mar.

description:
Hi all

so after this thread (http://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=3868.0), I went about updating a few missions I made for myself to v.53.1a and balancing them and everything.

here's the first 2 missions I updated, testing the water I suppose. One mission details my headcanon of how the mercenary ship black star came about, the other is the battle preceding the sinking of HSS Bis'mar.

v1.01:
-Added mission "fresh start"
-Added mission "last stand"

download link: http://www.mediafire.com/?ocpoabe8ab5jabc

enjoy!

(Should this be in the mods sub-forum? I can move it... It's just that it feels so lonely up there...)
